forme01: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one production sprite sheet using the five attached APPROVED Fronda icons as exact style and morphology references, ordered as Lepiota cap, Lepiota whole, Cortinarius cap, Cortinarius whole, Entoloma whole; derive the Entoloma cap-alone sprite directly from its whole-mushroom reference. Square canvas, transparent background, strict invisible 3x3 grid. Draw only six sprites: row 1 cells 0 and 1; row 2 cells 3 and 4; row 3 cells 6 and 7. Cells 2,5,8 are completely transparent. First column cap alone in side view; second column whole mushroom. Center each drawing in its cell, at least 18% clear margin on all four sides, no artwork touching adjacent cells. Preserve scale, thick dark-brown outlines, flat warm colors and simple highlights from the approved references. NO text, labels, grid lines, soil, shadows or extra features. Row 1 Lepiota brunneoincarnata: change ONLY the cap shape to hemispherical, a rounded half-dome, base cap color pink with the same brown-pink scales and short banded stem as references. Preserve the stem; do not add ring or volva (ring not documented, volva absent). Row 2 Cortinarius rubellus: change ONLY cap shape from pointed-conical to flat (piano); no cone or central pointed peak, cap horizontally spread. Same orange cap, cream stem, brown gills as reference; NO ring, volva or reticulum. Row 3 Entoloma sinuatum: change ONLY cap shape to conical (conico), a broad triangular profile with a central apex. Same gray cap, pink gills and stout pale stem as reference; NO ring, volva or reticulum. This is a schematic depiction of documented cap-shape alternatives, not a new identification portrait. Each whole mushroom must have the EXACT same new cap profile and cap color as the cap-alone sprite beside it.
forme02: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce a second Fronda mushroom sprite sheet using the THREE attached APPROVED whole-mushroom icons as the exact style and anatomical references, in their input order. Square 1254x1254 canvas, genuine transparent background, invisible equal 3x3 grid. Only cells 0,1,3,4,6,7 contain art; cells 2,5,8 completely transparent. For each row: left cell cap alone in side view, middle cell whole mushroom with IDENTICAL cap profile and coloration. Center everything with at least 15% clear margins; do not let any drawing cross a cell. Thick continuous dark brown outline, flat warm colors, simple highlights and light texture like the references. No labels, writing, grid lines, environment, shadow, extra specimens. Row 1 Amanita virosa: WHITE FLAT cap (piano), almost horizontal crown, no conical apex. Preserve the approved white stem, delicate ring, bulbous base inside a white sack-like volva. Do NOT remove the ring or volva. White gills; preserve smooth cap, no new warts. Row 2 Tylopilus felleus: CREAM FLAT cap (piano), horizontally extended not domed; pale pink pores below. Preserve stout stem and prominent coarse DARK-BROWN reticulum exactly as reference. No ring or volva. Row 3 Morchella esculenta: YELLOW HEMISPHERICAL cap (emisferico): a short, broadly rounded half-globe honeycomb cap, not tall, conical or pointed. Deep polygonal honeycomb pits and clear connected raised ridges, never brain-like folds. Whole mushroom: same short rounded honeycomb cap with its lower edge attached to a cream stem, as in the reference; no ring or volva. Do not introduce a cutaway or additional sections. Only documented shape alternatives change; all other traits remain as in the approved originals.
